clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he runs his whole company on three books most entrepreneurs never heard of.

Speaking From Experience taught his team org boards, battle plans and managing by statistics. Karmic Management is the second. The third isn't even a book - it's a paper system called Priority Manager he's used for over 30 years to set goals and get everything done on time.

For staff communication, he skips email and uses Telegram voice messages instead, ten times faster, he says.

No MBA, no consultants. Just three systems, repeated for decades.

What's the one system you still haven't put in place?

#kevintrudeau #businesstips #management #entrepreneur #productivity #wealthhabits
clips.send: A new manager handed a messy team sends it to a friend scaling a business, the anxiety of flying blind without a system.
